package fixture

import (
	"testing"

	quicktest "github.com/frankban/quicktest"
)

// Under this alias the identifier `qt` never appears, so R1 and R2 would both go
// quiet across the whole file. R0 exists so that silence is itself a finding.
func TestRenamedAlias(t *testing.T) {
	c := quicktest.New(t)
	quicktest.Assert(t, 1, quicktest.Equals, 1)
	c.Run("sub", func(c *quicktest.C) {
		c.Assert(2, quicktest.Equals, 2)
	})
}
